name: nodebase
description: Self-hosted Discord bot hosting and personal file cloud

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w runner && npm run build -w agent
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w runner && npm run test -w agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w runner && npm run typecheck -w agent
